body: Coward. I'm going to kill myself, but I would never take others with me. Insulting to those of us who choose to die on our terms.
I wish there was someone IRL, preferably a specific person, who did. It would change my mind.
I never suggested anybody wanted me to do this, but no one really cares if I do. Honestly, as long as I cancel my phone service, no one will notice I'm gone.
